baseFrontend: 7.9.75 consolidated runtime with universal native manual datapoint controls
label: v76
notes: Every state with common.write not equal to false has a deterministic manual control path based on its declared type and role.
Read-only states remain read-only; safety-relevant commands are writable only in expert mode and cannot be bypassed through the context menu.
Number, string, enum, mixed and JSON-backed values use the native ObjectBrowser value dialog with strict validation and visible write errors.
Boolean switches and button/trigger states use type-correct direct values, including numeric and string state mappings.
Write-only states remain visible and provide an explicit value target even when no current state exists.
All active module-federation entrypoints use the cache-separated v76 runtime.
changes: Support common.type number, boolean, string, mixed, object, array, json and legacy multi-type declarations.
Support object and array editors as validated JSON strings because ioBroker StateValue is scalar.
Preserve numeric enum keys and string enum keys without replacing values by translated labels.
Serialize repeated writes per datapoint instead of dropping concurrent manual commands.
Do not prefill write-only numeric states with zero; an explicit valid value is required.
Use common.def and explicit NexoWatt metadata for typed trigger values when available.
Protect expert-only commands in direct clicks, keyboard actions and the native context menu.
Keep source and delivered value-dialog behavior aligned for future clean builds.
